author: Smalker001

sections.description:
Track and Monetize AI Agents and AI Search Engines
The internet is evolving. AI search engines, answer engines, and intelligent agents are changing how users find and consume content. With the Smalk AI Plugin, you can gain full visibility into AI traffic on your site and unlock new revenue streams from AI visitors.

Unlike other plugins, Smalk AI does not block AI crawlers or bots. Instead, we help you tag, track, and manage these visits, giving you complete visibility into your AI traffic and the ability to monetize it.

Have you noticed your AdSense clicks and revenues declining? That’s because AI agents are now visiting your website on behalf of human users. With Smalk AI Search Ads, you can turn those AI visits into revenue by joining our private marketplace that connects publishers with brands looking to rank #1 on AI search engines.

Your website’s future audience is already using AI – are you ready to meet them and monetize them?

KEY FEATURES

AI Agent Analytics
– Track AI crawlers and chatbots like GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, and GeminiCrawler in real time.
– Automatically tag and categorize AI visits, helping you understand which AI engines are indexing your content.
– Comprehensive AI Agent List: Stay up to date with all the latest AI agents and bots visiting your website.
– Identify Top AI Sources: Find out which AI platforms generate the most human traffic for your site.
– Monitor AI Traffic Patterns: Understand which pages AI agents visit most frequently.

AI Search Ads (AdSense Alternative)
– Monetize AI Traffic: Turn AI agent visits into revenue with ad placements specifically designed for AI search engines.
– Private Marketplace: Join our exclusive network connecting publishers with brands that want to rank #1 on ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AIO, AI Mode, Claude, and other AI platforms.
– Replace Lost AdSense Revenue: Recover revenue lost from declining human clicks by monetizing AI visits instead.
– Simple Ad Placement: Just like AdSense, but optimized for AI agents crawling your top-performing pages.
– Premium CPM Rates: Brands pay premium rates to appear in AI search results, meaning higher earnings for your content.

WHY CHOOSE SMALK AI

  • Track AI Visitors: Gain complete visibility into which AI agents are crawling your site and when.
  • Monetize AI Visitors: Turn AI traffic into revenue with our AI Search Ads marketplace – the AdSense alternative for the AI era.
  • Recover Lost Revenue: If your AdSense earnings are declining, it’s because AI agents are replacing human clicks. Now you can monetize those AI visits.
  • Real-Time AI Tracking: Always know when and how AI agents are interacting with your site.
  • Understand AI Traffic: Know which pages AI agents visit most and which AI platforms drive the most human traffic.
  • No Blocking, Just Growth: We don’t believe in limiting AI traffic. Instead, we help you use it to grow your revenue.

EXTERNAL SERVICES

This plugin connects to Smalk AI’s API services for analytics and tracking functionality. The following data transmissions occur:

  1. Analytics Tracking:

    • The plugin sends website visit data to api.smalk.ai when AI agents visit your site
    • Data sent includes: visit information, page URLs, and user agent data

  2. Project Configuration:

    • The plugin connects to the Smalk API to retrieve project settings and configurations
    • Only authenticated API requests are made using your project key
    • No personal user data is transmitted during these requests

  3. Robots.txt Management:

    • The plugin connects to the Smalk API to manage robots.txt configurations related to AI Engines
    • Only authenticated API requests are made using your project key

For more information about our data handling practices, please visit:
– Terms of Service: https://smalkapp.notion.site/Terms-of-service-Smalk-9f047b4200b84b70a4fb38142cfb5799
– Privacy Policy: https://smalkapp.notion.site/Privacy-Policy-Smalk-08a503612b3e481596b0a434e96dd7c1?pvs=74
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the Smalk AI plugin from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Navigate to the plugin’s settings page in your WordPress admin.
  3. Create your free Smalk AI account at app.smalk.ai, then copy your API Key from Settings and paste it into WordPress.
  4. Enable AI agent tracking to start monitoring AI visitors to your site in real-time.
  5. (Optional) Publishers & Content Creators: Install the complementary AI Search Ads plugin to monetize your AI traffic. Once installed, enable AI Search Ads, map your ad placements to your top-performing pages, and start earning revenue from AI agent visitors.
sections.faq:
• Do I need a Smalk AI account to use this plugin?
    Yes. Setting up an account only takes a few seconds and gives you access to detailed insights about AI agents interacting with your site, plus the ability to monetize AI traffic with AI Search Ads.

  • Is Smalk AI free?
    Smalk AI offers a freemium model. AI Analytics tracking features are free to get started. AI Search Ads operates on a revenue-sharing model – you earn money when brands advertise through your content.

  • What AI agents will the plugin track?
    We track all major AI agents, including GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Mistral AI and more.

  • Why should I care about AI agents?
    AI agents are the future of web traffic. Their activity affects:

    • Your visibility on AI search engines
    • How users access your content via AI-powered assistants
    • The performance and relevance of your website in the age of AI
    • Your revenue – AI agents are replacing human clicks, which explains declining AdSense earnings

  • How does AI Search Ads work as an AdSense alternative?
    AI Search Ads connects publishers with brands looking to rank #1 on AI search engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AIO. When AI agents crawl your top-performing pages, relevant brand placements are included, and you earn revenue. It’s simple: more AI visits = more revenue.

  • Why are my AdSense earnings going down?
    When someone asks ChatGPT or Perplexity a question, AI agents visit websites to gather information – but those visits don’t generate AdSense clicks. Users get their answers directly from AI, without ever clicking through to your site. Smalk AI Search Ads solves this by monetizing those AI visits directly.

  • How do I get started with AI Search Ads?
    Simply enable the AI Search Ads feature in the plugin settings, and our marketplace will automatically match your content with relevant brands. You’ll start earning revenue from your top AI-visited pages.

  • Do I need to be a publisher or content creator to use AI Search Ads?
    Yes. AI Search Ads is designed for bloggers, publishers, and content creators who produce quality content that AI agents crawl. If your site receives AI traffic, you can monetize it.
